Elephant legs show repetitive wrinkle patterns and smearing at ground contact points (severity 2). While individual objects (elephants, violins) have reasonable anatomical detail, interaction zones and physical grounding reveal synthetic generation. The mask confidence (0.98) for bears reflects coherent segmentation but doesn't indicate artifact-free boundaries - the topology auditor cannot detect fusion when colors/textures are similar.
